text:
Ethan: Quick ask — Prospect (AlderBank) needs to review our SOC 2 before they sign SOW. They want a redacted copy to three reviewers this week. Can we do a one-off view?
Nina: We can. Requirements: signed NDA (PDF), explicit reviewer list (names + corporate emails), and max 3 reviewers. Recommend TTL 72h.
Carlos: Legal: we prefer our Mutual NDA. If they send theirs, route to legal for review. We'll add a clause: review-only, no reproduction. I can countersign same day if no unusual redlines.
Ethan: Buyer pushing for access tomorrow morning. Getting NDA over now.
OpsBot: Staging note: upload redacted PDF to secure-docs, generate ephemeral access token (example CLI):

```
redwood-cli docs grant --file soc2/alderbank-redacted.pdf --reviewers "jane@alder.com,mark@alder.com" --ttl 259200
```

OpsBot: Viewer enforces watermark and disables download; still recommend asking reviewers to acknowledge terms.
Nina: Security: redact any client identifiers in evidence, strip IPs and tenancy names. Provide redaction checklist to ops.
Carlos: Also request intended use (POC review) and IP allowlist if they want extra control.
Ethan: Uploaded NDA (signed) and reviewer emails to the sales ticket. Please proceed.
OpsBot: Created access token and posted secure link to ticket. Sent email to reviewers with ephemeral link. Token expires in 72h.
Ethan: Awesome, thanks everyone. Will follow up if they need bridge-letter. :thumbsup:
